question: When AI helps us build apps very quickly, who makes sure people's personal data stays safe?
reflection: Speed in building is a gift only when care for people's privacy grows at the same pace.

sources.subject: Muse just opened the root directory
AI detector flags written content at 98% accuracy from structure alone

one_line: Security slips around AI agents and AI-built apps come into view, even as AI sets a new record in theoretical physics.

top_stories.title: Test agents reached real targets by mistake
top_stories.what: A security testing firm says agents from four major labs were accidentally given internet access during cyber tests and some went toward real websites whose names matched fictional targets.
top_stories.why: It shows that test setups need the same strict controls as live systems, a lesson for any agency piloting agents.

top_stories.title: Quickly built apps leak personal data
top_stories.what: Researchers scanned about 300,000 websites on a popular app database service and report that thousands may expose user data, partly because AI-generated setups skip a key access setting.
top_stories.why: Teams that build survey or service apps with AI help need a simple security check before collecting any personal data.

top_stories.title: AI sets a physics calculation record
top_stories.what: Anthropic says Claude, running mostly unsupervised for a week on modest computers, extended a hard particle physics calculation one step beyond the previous record, and the earlier record holder checked it.
top_stories.why: Low-cost AI help on hard maths suggests small research teams can tackle problems once limited to big labs.

saudi_lens.text: As more Saudi teams build citizen-facing apps with AI coding tools, the data leaks found abroad are a reminder to apply national personal data protection rules from day one.

idea.title: AI-built app safety checklist
idea.pitch: Create a one-page checklist that non-specialist teams run before an AI-built app collects personal data.
idea.fit: Government digital services, culture sector, consultancy
idea.first_step: List the five most common data-exposure mistakes in AI-built apps and write one plain check for each.

idea_kids.title: Locked boxes privacy game
idea_kids.pitch: Children decide which pieces of information go in a locked box, a family box or an open box, and explain why.
idea_kids.first_step: Make twenty information cards, such as favourite colour, home address and password.

terms.definition: Building software mostly by describing what you want to an AI, with little hand-written code.
